decisions.finding: Consonant Kaf (letter 4) in מָרְדְּכָי sits at cols 1395..1365, rows 348..418 of extension-volumeA-560-zoom4-upper-right.png on Line 2. Directly beneath Kaf sits a classic Kahana-font Qamats with a solid horizontal bar at rows 426..434 (cols 1395..1370) and a distinct vertical stem descending from the center of the bar at rows 436..449 (cols 1386..1375). Pure white paper surrounds the stem on both left and right (values 255). Note is retired with Qamats restored under Kaf -> מָרְדְּכָי.

Initial consonant Lamed (letter 1) in לְמְלֹךְ sits at cols 1235..1215, rows 167..236 of extension-volumeA-560-zoom4-upper-right.png on Line 1. Directly beneath the base of the Lamed sit two circular punch dots stacked vertically at rows 248..252 and 264..268, centered at col 1219, separated by pure white paper at rows 256..260. This confirms a clear Sheva. Note is retired with Sheva restored to initial Lamed -> לְמְלֹךְ.
